## Appearance

Cecilia Meredith is small, dark, and vivacious in appearance. She is also noted for having dark-blue eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018)_

## History

Cecilia Meredith made hemstitched sheets and an embroidered spread for her spare room during her life. Before her death, she clasped her baby daughter to her heart after her other children had left the room weeping.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P95](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0095), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018)_

## Relationships

### [Carl](../character/carl.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carl--cecilia-meredith.md)

Cecilia Meredith is the mother of [Carl](../character/carl.md). Following her death, her children are left under the care of their distracted father in the manse, where they spend their time playing with other local youth in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), +6 more_

- Parent of  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>

### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-meredith--john-meredith.md)

Cecilia was the wife of [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) prior to her death. After her passing, John becomes deeply consumed by his theological studies and pastoral duties, leaving him struggling to manage the household and care for their children. He eventually attempts to move on by proposing to [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), though his devotion to Cecilia's memory and family remains central to his domestic troubles.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P15](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0015), +9 more_

- Spouse of — deceased wife  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-meredith--una-meredith.md)

Cecilia was the mother of [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md). After Cecilia's death, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) remains at the manse with her siblings, where her father fiercely protects her from being taken away and adopted by relatives like Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P95](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0095), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), +9 more_
